out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Parasite Destruction
violations.observation: The following fish offered for service or sale in the ready-to-eat form was not frozen to ensure parasite destruction: salmon fillet, smoke salmon
violations.corrective_action: Before service or sale in ready-to-eat form, raw or partially cooked fish shall be: 1) frozen and stored at a temperature of -4F or below for a minimum of 7 days in a freezer, or 2) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -31F or below for a minimum of 15 hours, or 3) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -4F or below for a minimum of 24 hours. Person in charge has agreed to fully cook all salmon products on menu.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed raw salmon fillets in produce walk in cooler thawing while reduced oxygen packaging was still intact.
violations.corrective_action: Person in charge discarded salmon fillets.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the 3-COMPARTMENT SINNK with a concentration of LESS THAN 150ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. CFM WILL NEED TO MANUALLY ADJUST THE CONCENTRATION OF SANITIZER BEFORE THE SANITIZER DISPENSER IS FULLY REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: SANITIZER DISPENSER AT 3-COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE SANITIZER DISPENSER AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.
